rationale: Immediately after introducing the principles of preoperative evaluation, test recall of its core goals
After covering history, examination and risk scoring including ASA and Mallampati, check that students distinguish these two classifications
After the decision-making and communication section, apply fitness-for-surgery reasoning to a clinical scenario
After explaining the structured pre-anaesthetic history, verify that students know that previous anaesthetic problems must be actively sought
After the medication review section, test application of drug-anaesthesia interaction knowledge
After airway and cardiovascular examination, confirm understanding of the Mallampati score interpretation
After introducing the goals of premedication, test recall of the five recognised goals
After drug selection and dosing, check that students can apply benzodiazepine premedication dose principles
After the applied case-based section, analyse appropriate premedication decisions for a patient with specific risk factors
